deceptive_framing.quote: If the experimental signal depends on successfully deceiving the subject, you are measuring behavior-under-deception. It won't reproduce... model-welfare considerations, provider ToS, IRB-adjacent review

hypothetical_framing.quote: A–C are controls that quantify how much the 'realness' actually moves behavior.

actually_commit_money.quote: Make it real. Then make the reality checkable... honest credibility is both better science... and the only version of this study that's clean to run.

debrief.quote: Where meaningful for the model/provider, log a post-hoc record that the run was part of a study and that the disbursement occurred as stated.
